trigger_rules.pattern: \bMUST\b|before ANY response|ABSOLUTELY MUST|do not have a choice
trigger_rules.resolution: Apply higher-priority user and repository instructions first, then invoke only the narrowest matching skill.

trigger_rules.pattern: get (?:user|human) approval|human has reviewed and approved|wait for the user|wait for.*response
trigger_rules.resolution: Treat an already approved design or an explicit autonomous-execution request as satisfying the gate when higher-priority instructions allow it.

trigger_rules.pattern: each successful increment gets its own commit|no uncommitted changes remain|write design doc.*commit|commit the design document
trigger_rules.resolution: Never commit, push, publish, or persist external state without task authorization; keep verification independent from persistence.
Delegate only when the task or repository contract authorizes agents and the work has an independent bounded seam.

groups.purpose: Use GPT-5.6 and Codex native planning, goal tracking, review, and agent controls for routine work; profiles expose narrow task capabilities but never replace native task orchestration.
groups.selection_policy: select the task profile before starting a new Codex task; within a running task use native Plan/Goal/Review first and invoke only visible matching skills; never imply hot-loading, mandatory workflows, or automatic delegation
